name: Aabcore Classified Ads
author: Aabcore web

sections.description:
Aabcore Classified Ads collects ad details, links, images, and metadata to promote ads across websites.

Aabcore Classified Ads – documentation. documentation.

3rd party service notice

This service is provided by “Aabcore”: terms of use, privacy policy

Third Party Services

This Classified Advertisement plugin does not send any user data to external servers. All features run locally on the user’s server.

External services links are :

General Features

  • Post free classified ads, promote your business, and connect with potential customers online.
  • Advertise for free, showcase your products and services, and reach more customers easily.
  • Promote your business online with free ads and grow your customer network.
  • Post free business ads, discover opportunities, and connect with buyers and sellers.
  • List your products and services for free and make your business more visible.
  • Share your business ads, attract new customers, and expand your reach online.
  • Buy, sell, and promote services with free classified advertisements.
  • Create free ads, showcase your offerings, and grow your business with ease.
  • Find local services, promote your business, and connect with your community.
  • Your free platform to advertise, promote services, and reach more people online.

Privacy

Plugin Information: Our Aabcore Classified Ads after receiving your permission, the plugin will collect the required information, such as your website name, email address, and plugin installation date, to help build Classified Advertisement for your website.

The plugin collects advertisement titles, descriptions, destination URLs, image URLs, and relevant image metadata. Submitted advertisement details may be used to prepare advertisements for display on other websites, subject to the applicable publishing arrangements and approval process.
sections.installation:
View detailed documentation.

  1. Install the Aabcore Classified Ads for WordPress plugin and activate it.
  2. From the WordPress Dashboard, navigate to Aabcore Classified Ads > Dashboard. Use these Dashboard to display Advertisement info.
sections.faq:
Q: What is Aabcore Ads?
Aabcore Ads is an online platform where users can post free classified ads, promote businesses, showcase services, and connect with potential customers.

Q: Is posting an advertisement free?
Yes, you can post free advertisements to promote your business, products, and services, subject to the platform’s terms and conditions.

Q: How can I post a free ad?
Log in to your WordPress account, install the Free Ads plugin, and go to your dashboard. Enter your advertisement details, upload images if needed, and click the Post Ad button to submit your advertisement.

Q: What types of ads can I post?
You can post ads for businesses, products, services, jobs, real estate, electronics, and other permitted categories.

Q: How can I promote my business?
Create an advertisement with a clear title, detailed description, relevant images, and contact information to help potential customers discover your business.

Q: Can I edit or delete my advertisement?
Yes, you can manage your advertisements from your account dashboard, where available, to edit, update, or remove your listings.

Q: How long does it take for an ad to appear?
Advertisements may appear after submission or after the required verification and approval process is completed.

Q: Can I upload images with my ad?
Yes, you can upload relevant images to make your advertisement more attractive and help customers understand your products or services.

Q: How can customers contact me?
Customers can use the contact details or communication options provided in your advertisement to inquire about your products or services.

Q: How can I report a suspicious advertisement?
Contact the website’s support team or use the available reporting feature to report misleading, inappropriate, or suspicious advertisements.

Q: What is the difference between free and premium advertising?
Free advertising lets you publish eligible ads without a posting fee. Premium advertising may offer additional promotional features, depending on the available plans.

Q: How can I get help with my advertisement?
Contact the website’s support team for assistance with posting, editing, verification, account access, or other advertising-related issues.

Uninstall plugin?

Uninstall plugin via the WordPress Plugins page (not on deactivation).
